// net.js
// RINGSIDE online play. Two browsers talk directly (WebRTC via PeerJS); the free public PeerJS server
// only introduces them. The host owns the match settings and the random seed; both screens apply the
// same moves in the same order, so the boards (and every ring event) stay identical.
window.RingNet = (() => {
  const P = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const api = {
    online: P.get('mode') === 'online' && !!P.get('room'),
    role: P.get('role') || 'host',
    room: P.get('room'),
    game: P.get('g') || '',
    connected: false,
    conn: null,
    peer: null,
  };
  // seeded random (mulberry32): both players roll the same ring events
  api.rng = seed => () => { seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 |
  // the invite always points at the public site, so a friend anywhere can open it
  const PUBLIC = 'https://wakeupsilver.github.io/1derworld/apps/ringside/';
  api.base = () => (/^(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)$/.test(location.hostname) ? PUBLIC : location.href.replace(/[^/
  api.inviteLink = (room = api.room, game = api.game) => `${api.base()}?join=${room}&g=${game}`;
  // ---- a little status pill in the corner ----
  let pill;
  api.say = (msg, withLink = false) => {
    if (!pill) {
      pill = document.createElement('div');
      pill.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;top:10px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:99;background:
      document.body.appendChild(pill);
    }
    pill.innerHTML = '';
    const t = document.createElement('span'); t.textContent = '🌐 ' + msg; pill.appendChild(t);
    if (withLink) {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.textContent = 'copy invite link';
      b.style.cssText = 'background:#ffd23f;color:#1a0838;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 10px;font:7
      b.onclick = async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(api.inviteLink()); b.textContent = '
      pill.appendChild(b);
    }
    pill.style.display = msg ? 'flex' : 'none';
  };
  api.send = d => { if (api.conn && api.conn.open) api.conn.send(d); };
  api.leave = () => { try { api.conn && api.conn.close(); api.peer && api.peer.destroy(); } catch { /* fine */
  // opts: { makeHello(), onHello(hello), onAct(action), onRematch() }
  api.start = opts => {
    if (!window.Peer) { api.say('online play needs a connection (PeerJS did not load)'); return; }
    const id = 'ringside-' + api.room;
    const wire = c => {
      api.conn = c;
      c.on('data', d => {
        if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return;
        if (d.t === 'hello') { api.connected = true; api.say(''); opts.onHello(d); }
        else if (d.t === 'act') opts.onAct(d);
        else if (d.t === 'rematch') opts.onRematch && opts.onRematch(d);
      });
      c.on('close', () => { api.connected = false; api.say('your opponent left the ring'); });
      c.on('error', () => api.say('lost the connection'));
    };
    if (api.role === 'host') {
      api.peer = new Peer(id);
      api.peer.on('open', () => api.say('waiting for your opponent to open the link…', true));
      api.peer.on('connection', c => {
        if (api.conn && api.conn.open) { c.on('open', () => c.close()); return; } // one opponent at a time
        wire(c);
        c.on('open', () => { const h = opts.makeHello(); api.send({ t: 'hello', ...h }); api.connected = true;
      });
    } else {
      api.peer = new Peer();
      // the host may not have rung the bell yet: keep knocking for a couple of minutes
      api.tries = 0;
      api.knock = () => { if (api.connected) return; api.tries++; wire(api.peer.connect(id, { reliable: true }
      api.peer.on('open', () => { api.say('stepping into the ring…'); api.knock(); });
    }
    api.peer.on('error', e => {
      const t = e && e.type;
      if (t === 'peer-unavailable' && api.role !== 'host' && api.tries < 40) { api.say('waiting for your chall
      api.say(t === 'unavailable-id' ? 'that invite is already in use: make a new one from the menu'
        : t === 'peer-unavailable' ? 'that match is not open right now: ask for a fresh link'
        : t === 'network' || t === 'server-error' ? 'cannot reach the matchmaking server right now'
        : 'connection problem (' + t + ')');
    });
  };
  return api;
})();

<!-- ======================= ENGINE (pure rules + search; also runs inside the AI worker) ====================
<script id="engine">
const W = 7, H = 6, NC = W * H, FALLS_TO_WIN = 3, HYPE_MAX = 100;
const MOVES = {
  chair: { cost: 30,  icon: '🪑', name: 'STEEL CHAIR' },
  cage:  { cost: 35,  icon: '⛓️', name: 'CAGE COLUMN' },
  tag:   { cost: 45,  icon: '🤝', name: 'TAG TEAM' },
  pile:  { cost: 60,  icon: '🙃', name: 'PILEDRIVER' },
  heavy: { cost: 100, icon: '🏋️', name: 'HEAVYWEIGHT' },
};
const MOVE_KEYS = ['chair', 'cage', 'tag', 'pile', 'heavy'];
const EVENTS = {
  collapse: { icon: '🕳️', name: 'FLOOR COLLAPSE', desc: 'the bottom row falls through the mat' },
  pyro:     { icon: '🎆', name: 'PYRO MISFIRE',   desc: 'three random pieces explode' },
  chairs:   { icon: '🪑', name: 'CHAIR SHOWER',   desc: 'the crowd throws chairs: +30 hype each' },
  blackout: { icon: '🌑', name: 'BLACKOUT',       desc: 'every piece looks the same for 2 drops' },
  quake:    { icon: '🌋', name: 'EARTHQUAKE',     desc: 'every row slides sideways' },
  flip:     { icon: '🙃', name: 'GRAVITY FLIP',   desc: 'the ring turns upside down' },
};
const DIRS = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [1, 1], [1, -1]];
const WINDOWS = (() => { const out = []; for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) for (const [d
  const er = r + 3 * dr, ec = c + 3 * dc; if (er < 0 || er >= H || ec < 0 || ec >= W) continue; out.push([0, 1
function newState(juice) {
  return { juice, cells: Array(NC).fill(0), turn: 1, falls: { 1: 0, 2: 0 }, hype: { 1: 20, 2: 20 }, used: [], 
           lock: { col: -1, victim: 0 }, moveNo: 0, winner: 0, timeout: false, blackoutUntil: 0, nextEvent: 7,
}
const cloneState = s => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));
const addHype = (s, p, n) => { s.hype[p] = Math.max(0, Math.min(HYPE_MAX, s.hype[p] + n)); };
const colOf = i => i % W, rowOf = i => (i / W) | 0;
function gravity(cells, moves) {
  for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) {
    let w = H - 1;
    for (let r = H - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
      const v = cells[r * W + c]; if (!v) continue;
      if (r !== w) { cells[w * W + c] = v; cells[r * W + c] = 0; if (moves) moves.push({ from: r * W + c, to: 
      w--;
    }
  }
}
// maximal runs of 4+ for either player
function findRuns(cells) {
  const runs = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) {
    const v = cells[r * W + c]; if (!v) continue;
    for (const [dr, dc] of DIRS) {
      const pr = r - dr, pc = c - dc;
      if (pr >= 0 && pr < H && pc >= 0 && pc < W && cells[pr * W + pc] === v) continue; // not the start of a 
      const run = []; let rr = r, cc = c;
      while (rr >= 0 && rr < H && cc >= 0 && cc < W && cells[rr * W + cc] === v) { run.push(rr * W + cc); rr +
      if (run.length >= 4) runs.push({ p: v, cells: run });
    }
  }
  return runs;
}
// Clear runs, apply gravity, repeat. Scores falls + hype. trace (optional) records steps for animation.
function resolve(s, trace) {
  let chain = 0; const scored = { 1: 0, 2: 0 };
  while (true) {
    const runs = findRuns(s.cells); if (!runs.length) break;
    chain++;
    const clear = new Set();
    for (const run of runs) { s.falls[run.p]++; scored[run.p]++; addHype(s, run.p, 25 + 12 * (chain - 1)); add
    if (trace) trace.push({ type: 'clear', runs, chain, board: s.cells.slice() });
    clear.forEach(i => { s.cells[i] = 0; });
    const mv = []; gravity(s.cells, mv);
    if (trace) trace.push({ type: 'fall', moves: mv, board: s.cells.slice() });
  }
  return { chain, scored };
}
function boardFull(cells) { for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) if (!cells[c]) return false; return true; }
function checkWinner(s, mover) {
  if (s.winner) return;
  const a = s.falls[1], b = s.falls[2];
  if (a >= FALLS_TO_WIN || b >= FALLS_TO_WIN) s.winner = a > b ? 1 : b > a ? 2 : (mover || 3);
  else if (boardFull(s.cells)) s.winner = a > b ? 1 : b > a ? 2 : 3;
}
const lockActive = s => s.lock.col >= 0 && s.lock.victim === s.turn;
function legalCols(s) {
  if (s.winner) return [];
  const out = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) if (!s.cells[c] && !(lockActive(s) && s.lock.col === c)) out.push(c);
  if (!out.length) for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) if (!s.cells[c]) out.push(c);
  return out;
}
function endTurn(s) {
  if (s.lock.victim === s.turn) s.lock = { col: -1, victim: 0 };
  s.turn = 3 - s.turn; s.used = []; s.heavy = false;
}
